experimental_objectives: Determine microgravity droplet/solid combustion behavior, extinction mechanisms, and limiting oxygen index (LOI).
sample_geometry_size: Spherical liquid droplet (2-5 mm initial diameter)
controlled_vs_varied_vars: Controlled: microgravity environment, ambient temperature; Varied: chamber pressure, O2/N2/CO2 concentration, initial droplet diameter
sensors_used: Visible color camera, Backlit droplet camera, LLUV (310 nm OH*) camera, pressure transducers, gas mass-flow controllers
earth_applications: Fine-water-mist fire suppression design, spacecraft/building smoke detector calibration (SAME/DAFT), and firefighter thermal protection.
citations: [SOURCE: JASMAC-33 FLEX w video.pdf | LOC: page_14]
key_findings_summary: Free-floating n-Heptane droplet burned in 20.0% O2 at 101.325 kPa and 298.15 K with a burn rate of 1.2 mm/s for 20.0 s inside CIR/MDCA.
